A cached cross-origin redirect must not let the redirecting origin revalidate the redirect target's cache entry.

On success, you will see a series of "PASS" messages, followed by "TEST COMPLETE".


PASS Revalidated the target's cache entry against the target, not against the redirect source
PASS Blocked read of cross-origin redirect's body, threw exception: TypeError: Load failed
PASS successfullyParsed is true

TEST COMPLETE
